title: _carryBuffer silently hardcodes set-aside buffer to 10% while live old strategies use 25% — a 60% reduction of the below-par staker cushion, only logged never asserted (operator footgun / faithfulness deviation)
description: _carryBuffer applies a hardcoded SETASIDE_BUFFER_PCT of 10% rather than reading the live on-chain value, while the deployed old strategies report a 25% set-aside buffer (fork-confirmed setAsideBufferSize(staker)==25). The inline comment / design doc S8 wrongly state the existing buffer is 10%, so an operator who trusts 'carry forward the existing buffer' silently more-than-halves the live cushion (a 60% reduction). The change is only logged (line 195), never asserted or enforced.
impact: Value/availability leak on the staker's liquidity cushion: new strategies launch with a 60%-smaller set-aside buffer that protects staker withdrawals. Under stress / below-par conditions the reduced cushion raises withdrawal-shortfall risk. Not direct theft — a degraded protective parameter. C4 Medium (value leak with stated assumptions + external requirement).
attackPath: Operator runs the migration believing they 'carry forward the existing buffer' (per inline comment / design doc S8, which wrongly states existing is 10%).
_carryBuffer applies the hardcoded 10% constant instead of reading the live 25%.
New strategies launch with a 60%-smaller set-aside buffer; the change is only logged, never asserted.
Under stress / below-par conditions, the reduced cushion increases withdrawal-shortfall risk for stakers.
recommendation: Read the live setAsideBuffer from the deployed strategy and carry it forward (assert new == live), instead of hardcoding 10%. If a deliberate change to 10% is intended, surface it explicitly as an operator-confirmed parameter with a post-condition assert and correct the comment / design doc S8 to match the live 25%.

evidence.observed: Drift only logged at line 195, never asserted.
evidence.externalRequirement: Realizes only once the script is unblocked (M-01/M-02 resolved); then the downgrade is automatic and silent.

footgunRationale: Non-obvious owner footgun (Law 3): the operator would be surprised that 'carry forward the existing buffer' silently more-than-halves the live cushion. In scope as an operational hazard with safe-config guidance (read+assert the live setAsideBuffer rather than hardcoding 10).
faithfulnessNote: Design doc S8 / inline comment misstate live config; routed to F-XX spec-conformance while retaining honest Medium per Law 1.
